summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a 6-K disclosing purchases of its own shares completing a buy-back programme announced 20 May 2025. Between 14-15 September 2026 the company bought for cancellation 86,499 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average of roughly EUR 22.24-22.27 and 50,210 ordinary shares underlying American Depositary Shares at roughly US $26.06-26.52. All repurchased shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The disclosure was made under EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 5(1)(b). Watch for completion of the programme and any new capital-return authorization.
